description: Look up a smart contract in CryptoTaxEdge's registry. Returns protocol metadata, contract type, verified ABI availability, label, and category hints. Use before deciding whether to classify a tx.
name: lookup_contract

category.description: A registry hint about what the contract is for. Not a transaction category and not a tax verdict.

found.description: Branch on this: false means the address is not in the registry, and the other fields are empty.

title: Look up contract metadata
